title: From Darkness to Light
story:
One evening, a family was hiking when thick fog suddenly covered the trail.

They could barely see where to step.

The children became frightened.

Just then, a park ranger arrived carrying a bright lantern.

He said,

“Stay close to me. I'll lead you safely.”

As they followed him, the path became clear.

The fear slowly disappeared.

Soon they reached the campsite, where warm lights and smiling faces welcomed them.

The children realized the ranger had not only shown them the way—he had brought them safely out of danger.

Before we knew Christ, we lived in spiritual darkness.

But God, in His great love, rescued us.

He brought us out of the kingdom of darkness and into the kingdom of His beloved Son.

Now we live in His light, guided by His truth and filled with hope.
life_lesson: God has rescued you from spiritual darkness and brought you into the kingdom of His beloved Son. Live each day in His light.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for rescuing me from the darkness of sin.

Thank You for bringing me into the kingdom of Your beloved Son.

Help me to walk each day in Your light.

May my life reflect Your love and lead others to You.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Can you remember how God has changed your life?

How can you walk more faithfully in His light today?

Who needs to hear about the hope found in Christ?
verse: Giving joyful thanks to the Father, who has qualified you to share in the inheritance of His holy people in the kingdom of light. For He has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of the Son He loves.
